source.zh-Hant: 港鐵官方飲水機名錄、官方站碼及地政總署車站／出口場地座標
source.en: MTR official drinking-water directory, official station codes and LandsD station/exit venue coordinates

records.nameEn: Admiralty Station drinking water dispenser
records.addressTc: 金鐘站：車站大堂B出口 (非付款區)
records.addressEn: Admiralty Station: Station Concourse Exit B (Unpaid Area)
records.locationTc: 車站大堂B出口 (非付款區)
records.remarksTc: 港鐵官方名錄所列補水機位；請自備水樽。路綫重複列項已去重，機位數不代表飲水機部數。官方未公布逐機過濾資料、水溫或確實服務時間。名錄未列停用公告，不代表即時可用。
records.remarksEn: Water-refill location listed by MTR; bring your own bottle. Duplicate line listings are removed; location count is not a machine count. Per-machine filtration, temperature and exact service hours are not published. No closure notice is listed; current availability is not guaranteed.
records.accessTc: 車站大堂非付款區；只可於港鐵車站開放時間內使用，並受現場安排限制，非24小時保證。
records.accessEn: Station concourse, unpaid area; access during MTR station opening hours, subject to on-site arrangements, not guaranteed 24-hour access.
records.locationNoteTc: 場地位置：採用地政總署金鐘站B出口座標，並非飲水機精確位置；請按官方大堂及出口描述尋找飲水機。
records.locationNoteEn: Venue location: LandsD coordinates for Admiralty Station Exit B, not the exact drinking-water dispenser position; follow the official concourse and exit description.
